Name: Daigo on the Ruff (KIWAMI UPDATE)
Author: EsotericEphemera
Description:
If you're looking for Daigo, you can find him in this mod.
This mod replaces grandpa's bed with a comatose Dojima Daigo from Yakuza 3. His fingers wiggle because he's ready to start blastin. 

Requires SMAPI, and Content Patcher.

[center][b]UPDATE 
KIWAMI MEANS EXTREME![/b]
Optional file now available to give Daigo slippers to reflect Yakuza Kiwami 3. Primary file is still Yakuza 3; Kiwami file is available in the update section.[/center]
